question: Does a no-change objective help beyond continued positive-caption training when forward examples, initialization, order and optimizer schedule are matched?
data: Exact same 256 records from invariance_sft_v1: 192 positive +64 geometric no-change. Both arms forward all records; only64 negative scalar losses are multiplied by0 versus1. Input text/images/targets identical, so positive exposure and RNG consumption remain matched.
checks: Verify all samples have valid assistant target tokens and finite unweighted losses; each arm sees384 positives and128 negatives. Compare LoRA/MDP initialization hashes and both epoch sampler orders. Only LoRA parameters trainable; non-LoRA trainable state empty.
evaluation: 72 fixed pairs: all48 new-scene geometry/natural cases +12 old natural +12 old identity. Published checkpoint and both adapters run sequentially in one GPU container with original prompt/BF16 base, greedy,1024 cap. Adapters stay FP32/unmerged for both training arms, to avoid numerical merge rounding as a confound.
assessment: Hide three model names per pair, same exact-sentence cleanup. Reuse labels only for exact case+question+entire displayed caption. Manually review new captions before decoding. Assistant review, not independent human validation.
selection: A candidate must reduce new-scene nonidentity physical-FP count versus published baseline, preserve natural fact hits in each domain on old and new groups, and not increase new confirmed-natural unsupported pairs. If both qualify, choose fewer physical-FP cases, then more natural hits. Report the matched-control contrast even if only one is promising. No parameter search within this ablation.
limits: Adaptive development images already viewed and used in previous pilots; one seed, few scenes, synthetic2D geometry. Zero-weight negatives still consume optimizer schedule and can affect momentum between steps, equally timed across both arms; the treatment is contribution of their objective, not simply extra training time.
budget: One sequential GPU app, timeout1800 seconds, 8CPU/64GiB/A100, conservative cost reservation before dispatch. No purchase or billing changes. Save results/checkpoints and release GPU on return.
